author: mrmmx31
description: Original IRIX Classic instrument monitor using native KDE System Statistics sensors; not the SGI executable or a binary emulation.

api_references.used: PlasmoidItem and native Sensor API conventions
Native daemon interface and sensor metadata

behavior: Seven real sensor subscriptions; unavailable data shown as a dash and an explicit sensor availability message.
CPU/MEM/SWAP bars use percentage scale; disk and network rates use each bar's observed peak, disclosed in the footer.
Native sensor updates limited to 1000ms; no production animation or polling Timer.
No mouse grabber overrides the native desktop widget movement or resize handles.
validation_tool: tools/testar.py: private plasmawindowed + native ksystemstats +3 samples + widget-only280x220 capture; no injected values
